analysis_type: Read-only post-hoc synthesis of three frozen native local-identifiability studies; no refitting, covariance recomputation or new experiment

rules.source_preservation: Use only stored frozen parameters, Jacobian diagnostics, period/denominator diagnostics, held-out prediction sensitivity and native test metrics; do not rerun optimizers, SVD, covariance or period fitting
rules.fold_coverage: Include all five folds from each dataset in input order Roszman1, Chwirut1, ENSO; no fold selection or cross-dataset reordering by performance
rules.sensitivity_error_ratio: For each fold, divide max local linearized prediction standard deviation by actual held-out RMSE; require finite positive values and preserve the raw numerator and denominator
rules.ratio_direction: Ratio greater than one means the maximum local sensitivity exceeds actual RMSE; ratio equal to one is retained separately and is not forced above or below one
rules.descriptive_counts: Count full-rank folds, local diagnostic failures and ratio-greater-than-one folds; these counts are not probabilities, calibration scores or model-quality rankings
rules.dataset_summaries: Within each dataset report raw minima, medians and maxima of scaled condition numbers, maximum parameter correlations and sensitivity/error ratios
rules.parameter_stability: Preserve every parameter-stability record in native units; do not normalize parameters into a common stability score
rules.scope_specific_evidence: Preserve Roszman1 parameter ranges, Chwirut1 denominator/pole and fold-1 b2 diagnostics, and ENSO period ranges, fold-4 period standard errors and harmonic correlation blocks
rules.cross_dataset_pooling: Do not pool residuals, RMSE, prediction standard deviations, covariance matrices, parameter values or condition numbers into a single error or stability metric
rules.known_answer_and_proof_scope: Keep ENSO optimizer-known-answer mismatch separate from certified forward evaluation; do not transfer rational certificates or describe local linearization as global identifiability or calibrated uncertainty

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生三模型局部可识别性综合_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, retuning, new starts, changed folds, new covariance estimates or new parameter values
No pooled cross-model residual, RMSE, sensitivity, covariance or parameter metric
No conversion of fold counts or sensitivity/error ratios into probabilities, calibrated coverage, effect sizes or universal stability scores
No ranking of model quality or physical validity by condition number alone
No claim of global structural identifiability, physical endogeneity, new physical periods, independent experiment or independent model-family replication
No erasure of folds whose sensitivity exceeds RMSE, fold-level parameter variation, denominator poles or harmonic compensation
No rewriting of the three frozen local-identifiability inputs
